# Global synthesis: a complete activation/repayment theorem, with the full frontier exposed

**Status.** A complete author-derived global proof and acquired finite certificate now cover the raw ordered-cycle family below, for every cycle length and every positive fixed rate vector. They establish nonexplosion, positive recurrence, all stationary exponential inventory/activity moments, and all polynomial moments of physical zero-return time. The family also has NO positive exponential physical return moment. The unrestricted weak-reversibility recurrence destination is NOT_ACHIEVED. This is the same history-exposed principal's construction and checking; no independent audit or historical-priority clearance is claimed.

## The ordinary baseline corrected the scientific decision

The former degree-seven diagnostic

    0 -> A+B -> 2A+B+C -> 3A+2B+2C -> 0

is deficiency zero, hence complex balanced for every positive rate vector. Its full recurrence and product-Poisson law were already ordinary established consequences of Anderson–Craciun–Kurtz (2010). The earlier stage's open global recurrence statement was a limitation of that construction, not an open mathematical result. That missed baseline is corrected explicitly here; completed source bytes remain unchanged.

Consequently the new construction targets the entire raw family

    y0=0, y1=(1,1,0), yj=(j,j−1,j−1), 2<=j<=k,
    y0 -> y1 -> ... -> yk -> y0,  k>=3,

with arbitrary positive constants kappa_0,...,kappa_k. All three inventories are free. Its rank is three and deficiency k−3. Generic k>=4 inputs are not complex balanced; k=4 with rates (1,1,1,1,2) is an explicit such input. Every member fails the accepted N1567 terminal-gap cone, by the raw divergence face I={B,C} and outside coordinate A. This is therefore a complete structural extension beyond those admitted premises, not a new proof only for a known degree-zero case. No assertion that all other ordinary methods fail is made.

# A global activation/repayment theorem for an ordered cycle family

Author-derived ordinary mathematical proof by the same principal. No independent review or historical-priority clearance is claimed. The unrestricted weak-reversibility conjecture remains open. The degree-seven k=3 member is an established complex-balanced baseline; the theorem below also covers arbitrary positive rates and generic non-complex-balanced members of unbounded deficiency.

## 1. Exact raw list and complete conclusion

Fix an integer k>=3. On three free count coordinates (A,B,C), let

    y0=(0,0,0), y1=(1,1,0), yj=(j,j−1,j−1) for 2<=j<=k.

The genuine channels are yi->yi+1, 0<=i<k, and yk->0. Their fixed constants kappa_0,...,kappa_k are all positive. Propensities are kappa_i (x)_(yi), with ordinary integer falling factorials and no hidden factorial divisors. Put

    M=A+B+C, q(x)=sum_i kappa_i (x)_(yi).

**Theorem.** This CTMC on N^3 is nonexplosive and irreducible positive recurrent. For its unique stationary law pi and every r>0,

    E_pi [(1+q(X)) exp(r M(X))] < infinity.                     (1)

Every positive physical return to zero has all finite polynomial moments. It has NO positive exponential moment; SLOW_CLOCK_CALIBRATION.md proves this compatible constraint.

The proof constructs one global physical return/occupation contract across all faces, including high A and low B/C. For positive rational rates and rational 1<u<t it acquires explicit finite chart constants and an integer finite-head radius for the reward F=(1+q)u^M. The receiving function off the slow section is constructed as a finite expected stopped occupation, with a proved bound, rather than supplied as an oracle. Exact enormous moment bounds can be retained as factored expressions; no practical performance or polynomial binary-input complexity is claimed.

The growth increments are

    u0=(1,1,0), u1=(1,0,1), ui=(1,1,1) for 2<=i<k;

the degradation decrement is v=yk=(k,k−1,k−1). Every growth increases A by one, increases total count by at most three, and never decreases B or C. Degradation decreases A by k and total count by 3k−2. Also q(x)>=kappa_0.

## 1. A matched ordinary calibration comes first

For the family in GLOBAL_ORDERED_CYCLE_THEOREM.md, the k=3 member has deficiency zero. Its positive recurrence and product-Poisson law are established by Anderson, Craciun and Kurtz, *Product-Form Stationary Distributions for Deficiency Zero Chemical Reaction Networks* (2010), Theorems 4.1–4.2. [Primary author copy](https://people.math.wisc.edu/~craciun/PAPERS_NEW/Anderson_Craciun_Kurtz_ProdFormFinal_2010.pdf).

For every k, whenever the exact complex-balance rate identities in the global proof hold, let c=(a,b,c) be that proof's positive balance point. The stationary exponential/activity reward has the explicit ordinary value

    E_pi [(1+q(X))u^M]
      =exp((u−1)(a+b+c)) [1+kappa_0 sum_(j=0)^k u^|yj|].       (C1)

Indeed independent Poisson factorial tilting gives E[(X)_y u^M]=c^y u^|y| exp((u−1)sum c), and every cycle flux kappa_j c^yj equals kappa_0. At k=3 and all unit rates this becomes

    exp(3(u−1)) [2+u^2+u^4+u^7].                             (C2)

The new global compiler's huge bound is substantially worse on this ordinary admitted locus; it supplies no computational or scientific advantage there. Generic k>=4 rates violate complex balance, and only there is the comparison premise different. Historical novelty beyond these governing baselines has not been established.
